body:
REWORK READY: PR #2676 at e1a40a89bc (BUG-2148)

Addressed all round 1 findings:
1. Blocking 1 (agent stop): Live processes with unconfirmed identity are not signalled, their registry entries are preserved in place, and agent_stop_in_project reports and bails nonzero. Verified with unit test asserting entry remains, process unharmed, and Err returned.
2. Blocking 2 (SIGKILL re-check & session_end):
   - Factored terminate_pids_with_grace into terminate_pids_with_grace_with supporting injected matchers and lenient survivor check. Only confirmed targets are evaluated for survival.
   - Added bug_2148_terminate_pids_sigkill_recheck_aborts_kill_if_identity_changes verifying pass-TERM/fail-KILL on a SIGTERM-trapping child (SIGKILL aborted, process survives).
   - Factored session_end leaked process handling into collect_leaked_claude_targets and leaked_to_terminate_targets with exact start identity; added bug_2148_session_end_leaked_process_identity_gating verifying identity capture and signal suppression on recycled identities.
3. Blocking 3 (Portability ratchet): Quoted TOML paths with toml_quote::toml_string, placed Unix shell trap test behind #[cfg(unix)]. scripts/check-portability.sh passed cleanly with 0 findings.
4. Non-blocking items:
   - Used process_identity_is_alive for survivor check in terminate_pids_with_grace.
   - Used process_start_identity_exact in session_end and TerminateTarget::from_live_process.
   - Wrapped test children in ProcessGuard (kill-on-drop) to eliminate leaked processes.

Verification:
- cargo fmt --all -- --check: Clean
- scripts/check-portability.sh: 0 ratchet findings
- cargo test -p aida-cli-lib bug_2148: 4 passed in 6.58s
- make check-ci-fast: 29 gates passed
- make check-ci-compile: All test targets compiled cleanly under agent profile
